cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

mechanism: A copies a measuring gesture as strange expertise and invents cloud-pricing rules to cover each correction or result.
confusable: D162 invents necessary rules while claiming mastery; D161 changes the mission itself.
comparison: Selling a bottled cloud versus rescuing furniture and a deposit.
seedUse: Use two elbows, address and rain as cumulative constraints; give the final measurement a reason within the sale.
